verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU. It has no in-product software surface that could analyze a user's data and generate insights, so this story is a category error for a hardware processor. The evidence only shows AI acceleration hardware (CPU/GPU/NPU) and support for third-party apps and Microsoft Copilot+. Those are host-platform and partner capabilities that run on the chip, not insights delivered by the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
